quality_screen.rule: Accept recorded acreage only for one unambiguous polygon feature when absolute difference from complete county polygon area is <= max(0.03 acre, 15% of polygon acres). Otherwise keep acreage missing or conflicted.
quality_screen.unit_check: Native EPSG3436 polygon area independently agrees with the stored area field; service display CRS is not used.
quality_screen.limitation: GIS-footprint agreement is a quality screen, not a legal survey or independently updated assessor record.
